title: Gem Reference Mesh And B-Rep Assets
cases: 24 cut/shape assets, unique `asset_key`s, monotone size ladders
every asset builds a closed mesh at its min/mid/max ladder size with bbox == spec
round diamond 6.5 mm -> bbox 6.5 x 6.5 x 3.95 within 1e-6
cabochon dome is closed with a flat bottom
round, oval, emerald, baguette, heart, trillion, cabochon and a custom profile each convert to one valid closed B-Rep whose source volume equals the mesh volume within 1e-6 relative
the loader's committed body is `Geometry::Brep` with the mesh volume, and a property edit keeps it a B-Rep
the open gem tool exposes a world-space preview mesh and placement while the document has no gem object yet
the positioner preview mirrors Move, Rotate and Scale and equals the committed placement
oracle: asserted by the registered tests; see observed.json
